children: Meshflow signed a Business Combination Agreement to merge with HGP Intelligent Energy in an $800 million stock deal, issuing 80 million Pubco shares at $10.00 per share following Meshflow’s Delaware domestication and dual mergers into Pubco. The parties intend to list Pubco’s common stock and warrants on a national exchange, with closing conditioned on shareholder approvals, a $40 million minimum cash requirement, and PIPE proceeds. To enhance execution certainty and post-close stability, Meshflow also secured a Sponsor Support Agreement, a Transaction Support Agreement with HGP members, and a Lock-Up Agreement covering HGP holders and SPAC insiders.

: Ensure member approval and deal execution

: Lock-up agreement for Pubco shares post-closing
: HGP Lockup Shareholders and SPAC insiders; Leyte Parent
: 180 days post-Closing with early release triggers
: Promote orderly trading and alignment post-merger
